messages:
jia: FYI, saw a regression after the kernel switch on the INT4 path — 8-12% per-token latency increase on our long-context gen tests (16k). KV cache hit rate dropped ~6% on the same runs. Anyone seen this?

owen: which kernel change? the recent mixed-precision GEMM selector change?

jia: yeah, the patch that prefers int4_gemm for small-seq kernels. bench-bot reproduced and attached counters.

bench-bot: [automated] profile summary: throughput -12%, p50 per-token +11ms, kv_cache_hits 94% -> 88%, kernel_select_counts: int4_gemm: 42k (was 18k), fp8_fused_gemm: 8k (was 32k)

sam: hmm suggests selector over-eagerly picks int4 for layers where quant calibration was suboptimal. Could be quant scale saturation -> extra dequant ops? Do we have per-layer kernel counters? :thinking:

jia: yes — ran per-layer kernel_counts dump: ```
layer 5: int4_gemm=1200 fp8_fused=10
layer 6: int4_gemm=1100 fp8_fused=8
layer 12: fp8_fused=1500 int4=40
```

mira: are we sure it's kernel choice and not batching heuristic? I saw batch sizes drop due to new prefetcher interfering with request coalescing.

jia: good point — I toggled prefetch off, batching returned to usual shape and p50 dropped back by ~6ms. With prefetch on, average batch size was 1.7 -> 1.1 for these requests.

owen: so two interacting regressions: selector picks int4 for layers with high mispredicted quant scales + prefetch reduces batch size -> int4 per-token overhead amplifies.

sam: what about KV cache misses? why did hits drop?

jia: prefetch touches KV in weird order; we discovered prefetch pattern invalidates small LRU entries and causes extra KV lookups. Telemetry: kv_evictions +3k/s when prefetch enabled.

mira: let's file rollback candidates: 1) revert selector to previous threshold, 2) disable prefetching for long-context route, 3) add per-layer calibration confidence to selector.

owen: quick mitigation: add gating rule — require fp8_fused weight if calibration_confidence < 0.9 OR batch_size < 2. That should push hot layers back to fp8.

jia: test patch incoming, bench script: ```
./bench/long_ctx.sh --model gptx-16k --iters 200 --telemetry counters,kv,latency
```

bench-bot: scheduled nightly run with new gating rule; results expected in ~12h

sam: also add counter names to observability dashboard: kernel.chosen, kernel.latency.p50, kv.evictions, batch.size.hist. Need dashboards for route-level.

mira: +1. Add an alert if kv_evictions_rate > baseline*1.5 or per_token_latency delta > 8%.

jia: assigning: owen to patch selector, sam to dashboards, mira to rollback playbook & alert. I'll monitor bench runs. @infra-bot can you pin rollout hold? :raised_hands:

infra-bot: Rollout hold set for r/serve/production for model gptx-16k

jia: thanks. I'll post updates in the morning.
